sources.label: Official The North Face UK size charts (Men's: Jackets & Tops chest/hip; Trousers & Shorts letter-size waist), cm

audit: thenorthface.co.uk now redirects to thenorthface.com/en-gb; old /help/size-guide URL is gone. Men's tab read (no bot check this time). Chest and hip from the Jackets & Tops chart; waist from the letter-size Trousers & Shorts chart on the same tab (its hip ranges are identical to the tops chart). Stored values were low at M and below and had no hips: M chest 99 -> 100-108, waist 84 -> 84-90; L chest 106 -> 109-117, waist 91 -> 91-99; XL chest 113 -> 118-126. 2XS and 3XL added; hips added. UK/US/EU removed: TNF publishes no letter-to-UK/EU conversion for tops (the numeric UK/EU columns belong to the waist-sized trousers chart). Note TNF's printed S (94-100) and M (100-108) chest ranges share 100 cm.
